messages:
Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert: error rate spike on /v1/generate (prod-us-east). 5xx increased from 0.1% -> 7% starting 15:32 UTC. Paging on-call: @Alex H
Alex H: I'm on it, looking at canary metrics + recent deploys. Which deploy went out around 15:20?
Samir D: deploy pipeline shows a model rollout at 15:18: tag=release/2026-03-12-models, artifact=redwood-models:prod-v4, but I see a parallel weights push with tag=ablation/exp-embed.
Alex H: can you paste the pipeline event?
Samir D: here's the k8s rollout log snippet:
```
kubectl apply -f deploy/model-serving.yaml --record
deployment/model-serving: starting rollout for image=registry/redwood/model:prod-v4
ConfigMap model-config -> updated by ci-cd (commit: d4f7b9)
Weights object updated: s3://weights/prod/ablation-v3/weights.tar.gz
```
Alex H: ohhhh. weights object points at ablation-v3 while image is prod-v4. possible mismatch causing tokenizer/vocab differences.
Maya R: on tokenization note, we've seen earlier that ablation-v3 uses BPE-v2 tokenizer (vocab size 50288) while prod-v4 uses BPE-v1 (50256) -> likely OOB token ids.
Rachel L: Customer impact: support queue shows ~40 errors from two customers using streaming endpoints, error payload includes "tokenizer: unknown id" in some traces.
Ops Pager: Attaching current SLO breach metrics: 5xx QPS peaked 320, baseline 12. Affected regions: us-east, us-west (due to routing fallback).
Alex H: okay, immediate mitigation options: 1) kill feature flag for 'use-prod-v4' to stop traffic to new model 2) update weights pointer to prod-v4 weights 3) rollback deployment to previous replica set. Preference?
Samir D: I'm ready to re-point weights quickly (s3 object change) but that still requires syncing KV cache invalidation. Rollback is safest and fastest.
Maya R: agree rollback. I'll open a rollback and kill the canary traffic.
Alex H: Maya - please do the rollback and post the kubectl command you run. I'll notify support + customers.
Maya R: running rollback now:
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/model-serving --to-revision=42
# revision 42 = stable before 15:18 deploy
```
Maya R: rollback started -> pods terminating, new pods coming up on rev 42.
Oncall Bot: Deploy bot: Rollback triggered by @Maya R for deployment/model-serving at 15:40 UTC (thread 1769994321).
Alex H: killing the feature flag now: `ffctl set use-prod-v4 false --env=prod`
Samir D: invalidating prefix cache for affected canaries:
```
redis-cli -h cache-01 del prefix:models:prod-v4
```
Rachel L: I'm sending an update to affected customers: "We've detected increased generation errors; we rolled back to a stable model version at 15:40 UTC and are monitoring. Expect normal behavior within 5-10 minutes."
Ops Pager: 15:44 UTC - 5xx rate dropping to 0.9%, error logs show remaining tokenization mismatches but tailing off.
Alex H: metrics look good -- latency and 5xx trending back to normal. I'll keep monitoring for 30 mins.
Maya R: Confirm rollback completed: all pods on rev 42, replicas=12 healthy.
Samir D: investigating root cause: CI/CD published model image and weights in two separate steps; weights job used branch-specific pointer and accidentally used an experimental S3 path because variable `WEIGHTS_TAG` defaulted to branch name when not set. Patch incoming to pipeline.
Alex H: Good find. Create an incident ticket (ENGINC-?) and assign SRE + CI owners. Also add a guard in deploy pipeline to fail if image tag and weights tag mismatch.
Rachel L: I've added initial customer-facing note in Zendesk and linked to support thread 8843. Also sent an internal status email to sales for impacted customers.
Oncall Bot: Handoff reminder: Alex H will be primary for next 30 minutes, then hand over to Maya R for 12hr on-call window.
Alex H: Postmortem to include: timeline, pipeline variables, S3 weight pointer mismatch, tokenizer version matrix, automated tests to validate tokenizer/vocab compatibility, and a kill-switch runbook.
Maya R: I'll open the rollback PR and the pipeline guard PR now. Assigning to @Samir D for CI changes.
Samir D: creating PRs: CI fix -> https://git.internal/redwood/ci/pulls/298 (add weights tag validation), Deploy docs -> https://docs.internal/redwood/deploys#model-weights (draft).
Alex H: final check: error budget still safe, SLO restored. Closing pager after 30m monitoring unless we see regression. Good job team :thumbsup:
Rachel L: I'll follow up with affected customers with final note after postmortem.
Maya R: noted, switching to incident mode, will add detailed logs and artifacts to the ticket.
Oncall Bot: Incident Slack thread archived to incidents channel (thread 1769994321) at 16:19 UTC.
